follow-up time: Not clearly specified, but includes the perinatal period and potentially up to discharge/death
cohort: 60 term newborns admitted to a tertiary care center with perinatal asphyxia (APGAR score ≤6 at 5 minutes)
finding: Out of 60 newborns with perinatal asphyxia, 8% died, with all stage III HIE cases and two cases of MAS with early onset sepsis contributing to the mortality.
mod_finding: 70% of the asphyxiated newborns were delivered vaginally, 25% by cesarean section, and 5% by instrumental delivery.
birth_weight: 80% appropriate for gestational age, 16% IUGR, 3% large for gestational age
